participant_id.Description: Original public release subject code (NWB general/subject/subject_id); no demographic inference.

grid_placement.Description: Column "Grid Placement", verbatim, Supplementary Table 1 "Clinical information" of Bouchard et al. 2013, Nature 495:327, doi:10.1038/nature11911 (Supplementary Information, 41586_2013_BFnature11911_MOESM48_ESM.pdf). Only sub-EC2 is listed under the same code in that table (its left 256-electrode grid, NWB group "L256Grid", agrees). The table also lists EC33 and EC31, which cannot be matched to GP33/GP31 with certainty, and EC9 is not listed: n/a for those.
